components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); font: 500 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: hsl(var(--primary) / 0.9); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action with a quiet border.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--input)); border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(var(--background)); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font: 500 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: hsl(var(--accent)); color: hsl(var(--accent-foreground)); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Laravel Manager adapts April UI v1.3 into a restrained operating surface for managing Laravel applications on one server. Moss-tinted surfaces, a soft clay action color, crisp line icons, and clear border rules keep attention on app identity, status, domains, branches, PHP versions, and server settings. System sans carries interface text; monospace marks technical values an operator checks or copies.

At desktop sizes, the April sidebar anchors navigation while each page uses a focused heading and action area above a compact list or form. At narrow widths, navigation opens as a slide-in panel, app rows become cards, and form actions stack. Surface tints and borders provide depth without prominent shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Moss neutrals establish the broad canvas and sidebar.
Warm clay is reserved for the primary action and compact product mark.
Compact system sans typography carries labels and operational details.
Technical values use monospace; surfaces stay flat and border-led.

rules.name: The Clay Action Rule
rules.body: Keep the clay accent on primary actions and the compact product mark; let the moss neutrals carry the rest of the screen.

rules.name: The Technical Value Rule
rules.body: Use monospace for values that behave like technical identifiers; keep ordinary labels and prose in the system sans stack.

rules.name: The Border-Led Depth Rule
rules.body: Show grouping with a tint or border before adding elevation.

dos: Do keep the broad surface moss-neutral and reserve clay for the primary action and compact product mark.
Do use monospace for domains, paths, and other technical values.
Do separate app data and settings with compact spacing, readable labels, and thin borders.
Do carry the sidebar menu into a slide-in mobile panel and present mobile app rows as cards.
donts: Don't turn the control room into a decorative marketing surface.
Don't add prominent shadows to ordinary cards or detail sections.
Don't use monospace for ordinary interface prose or labels.
